test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word DOLPHIN (in both the forward and backward directions) which have as many letters between them in the words as there are in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
Given word: DOLPHIN

The alphabets are positioned in the following order-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/390d9c4de9716ad54a712b7e92397299c916ab84a96e974e474ba95b770b96a5.png] 

The given word can be represented as follows-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/406cf7fe80bd1dfcaf8511a3401a683f86ed35fe64cc6beb2720174774e3ccaa.png] 

In forward direction: DH, DI, HI

In backward direction: IL

Thus, here are four pairs of such letters.

Hence. **'option 2' **is the correct answer.
